title: ChatHealthy Logs Record
description: One log document in admin.ChatHealthyLogs_{env}. Schema is closed (no extra fields). The canonical operational finds: db.find({fatal_error: true}) returns every 503; db.find({session_guid: <guid>}) returns every log of one user's session. user_action=true logs MUST carry session_guid. The full message bytes - including ChatHealthyException rendering, thrower traceback, and catcher stack - live in the `formatted` field; engineers grep there.

timeStamp.description: UTC datetime of the log emit. ISO 8601.

target.description: Per-build HF Space name (e.g. dev_SharedServicesSpace_1605) for HF deploys; container name (e.g. ch-sharedsvc) for local docker deploys.

formatted.description: Canonical byte stream identical to the file log line, including ChatHealthyException rendering and BOTH the thrower's and catcher's stack tracebacks when an exception is captured. Mongo IS the log; this field is the log line. Grep here for traceback content.

pathname.description: Absolute path of the Python source file where the log was emitted.

fatal_error.description: True iff this log represents a fatal 503 outcome (HTTP 503 response from the asgi middleware OR an unhandled exception). Always present; default false. Canonical query: db.find({fatal_error: true}).

user_action.description: True iff this log was produced while handling a user-driven request. When true, session_guid is required.

session_guid.description: Browser session GUID, 32 lowercase hex characters, or null when no user session is in flight (system / startup / background). Always present on every doc — never omitted. Canonical session-trace query: db.find({session_guid: <guid>}).sort({timeStamp: 1}). Indexed.

exc_type.description: Exception class name when an exception is captured. Indexed - db.find({exc_type: 'KeyError'}) buckets errors by class. The full thrower + catcher tracebacks are inside `formatted`.

http_status.description: HTTP response status code from the asgi middleware. Indexed for 5xx queries.

http_path.description: Request URL path from the asgi middleware. Indexed for per-endpoint traces.

lineno.description: Source line number where the log was emitted. Dev-debugging context, not indexed.

funcName.description: Source function name where the log was emitted. Dev-debugging context, not indexed.
